subQuests.subQuestName: Wait until 16:00 and find Nahida in the Sanctuary of Surasthana

30280102.text: I'm done with the parts that needed my involvement to complete.

30280103.text: Although it's my first time working with the Akasha like this, its internal structure and operation procedures are easy for me to understand. Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's design is truly brilliant.

30280104.text: Oh, also, this is for you.

30280105.text: Huh? What's this little floaty thingy?

30280106.text: It's a small device I put together just now. You can think of it as an upgraded Akasha Terminal.

30280107.text: You may not need it right now, but it should be helpful in certain situations.

30280108.text: Wait! This thing has the same characteristics as Paimon!

30280109.text: We're both small things that float...

30280110.text: *sigh* All the things that make Paimon special got copied... When Paimon appears with the Traveler from now on, people won't remember Paimon because she isn't unique anymore...

30280113.text: It's alright, Paimon. It can't replace you.

30280114.text: #It's only a flying device, but you're {NICKNAME}'s irreplaceable friend.

30280115.text: #Waah, you're so good at comforting people, Nahida. If only {NICKNAME} was as smart as you...

30280117.text: Hm? I was simply telling you what I feel to be the truth. I wasn't trying to comfort you.

30280118.text: Nahida, you're a natural at this! What you just said made Paimon even happier!

30280119.text: By the way, there's something I need to confess...

30280120.text: Even though I'm the archon and in control of myself again, I'm not very good at fighting...

30280121.text: You may have heard that an archon's power is derived from their people's faith. However, I'm not as well-loved as Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

30280122.text: If we get into a situation where combat is our only option, I'll have to count on you, and I'll do my best to provide support.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Nahida once you have made your preparations
Go through the passage and reach The Balladeer

30280501.text: What is this place? Is this really the way we need to go?

30280502.text: Wow... Who woulda thought there'd be a place like this hidden right slap bang in the middle of the city!

30280503.text: The sages wanted to realize their god creation plan without being discovered. The safest and most convenient way would be to build within the Akademiya itself.

30280504.text: Hmm, that's true. They were already hiding one god, so why not two?

30280505.text: Judging from the structure here, the project is a huge undertaking. The sages really saw the god creation plan as their ultimate goal.

30280506.text: But this place doesn't seem like it could have been constructed by the Akademiya alone...

30280507.text: The Fatui under The Doctor sure didn't hold back — they provided a lot of technological support.

30280508.text: It's to help one of their own Harbingers become a god, after all.

30280509.text: Yeah, or else they wouldn't have been that generous!

30280510.text: Is that it, though? I've always felt that this "Doctor" is different from the Akademiya sages. He doesn't seem to share their sense of urgency...

30280511.text: Instead of being interested in the end product, it's like he's enjoying the experimental process.

30280512.text: Hmm... The Fatui Harbingers are all such weirdos, so The Doctor being weird is actually normal.

30280513.text: So... this Fatui that they're trying to turn into a god... is called "The Balladeer"?

30280514.text: We had previously come into contact with his consciousness. He harbors particularly strong obsessions...

30280515.text: One is the desire for a Gnosis, since he was created to be the vessel for one.

30280516.text: The other obsession is probably related to his past. I can't quite explain it.

30280517.text: Paimon knows that he was a prototype puppet for the Raiden Shogun before he became a Fatui Harbinger...

30280518.text: That's why he wants a Gnosis so badly. There's no way he'd willingly be a test subject, not with that temper and ego of his.

30280519.text: It sounds like you know The Balladeer quite well.

30280522.text: I see. Tell me more about him and what he's like...

30280523.text: The more we know now, the better we can plan for and react to any future situation.

30280524.text: You tell Nahida everything you know about The Balladeer...

30280526.text: Alright, time to go. Let's get through here and meet him in person.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go through the passage and reach The Balladeer

30280401.text: Looking at its operational status, we must prepare for the worst. The god they wanted to create... is likely close to completion, or already completed.

30280404.text: Oh no, what should we do... Paimon can't imagine how hard it would be to fight against a Fatui Harbinger with a Gnosis...

30280406.text: If you really want to know... of course Paimon's nervous! Aren't you too, Nahida?

30280407.text: Yes, I am. This is probably the first time I'm faced with a calamity of this degree since my birth.

30280408.text: I feel not just nervous, but curious as well.

30280411.text: To me, everything we perceive in this world, everything we learn, and everything that happens to us is considered knowledge.

30280412.text: And if it's a form of knowledge, then it can be understood.

30280413.text: However, only fate is about that which has yet to occur, so it has always drawn my curiosity.

30280414.text: So to me, "fate" is the ultimate knowledge.

30280415.text: That's also why I love observing humans and all the things that happen to them. It all brings me great satisfaction.

30280416.text: And now, at long last, I'm not just an observer anymore.

30280417.text: I will personally experience my own fate, with you by my side. Hehe, isn't this such a wonderfully exciting thing?

30280418.text: Ah, so that's what you mean! Paimon thinks she understands what you're feeling.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to where The Balladeer is

30280701.text: This imposing aura... It really feels like a god's...

30280702.text: A body that capitalizes on The Balladeer's original construction as a mechanical puppet, with the Gnosis serving as a constant power supply...

30280703.text: How much effort and resources did the sages put into this...?

30280704.text: From a purely technological perspective, it's a commendable achievement indeed. It's no exaggeration to say this is the culmination of human wisdom.

30280705.text: You sure are something, dishing out compliments at a time like this...

30280706.text: But I don't think he's reached the spiritual height of a god.

30280709.text: Strife is engraved upon every god and every Gnosis brought forth into this world.

30280710.text: Can you feel it? The exhilaration of such power, and the thrill of anticipation for our contention...

30280711.text: Nahida wouldn't feel the same things as you!

30280712.text: Do you not realize... that you are interrupting a conversation between gods? Lowly creature, know your place!

30280714.text: Still the same Balladeer we know...

30280715.text: The strife engraved upon a Gnosis... You're talking about the Archon War.

30280716.text: Teyvat's current peace was not easily won. I didn't personally participate in the Archon War, but the way I see it...

30280717.text: All those losses were meaningless, driven by the demands of the "laws." There's no point in bringing it up again.

30280718.text: Hehehe, is that so? Yet I am deeply disappointed that I was never allowed the fortuity to personally participate in the Archon War.

30280719.text: This is a first — encountering a god in this world who does not crave power.

30280720.text: No wonder your own people have abandoned you, God of Wisdom.

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the Everlasting Lord of Arcane Wisdom
Defeat the Everlasting Lord of Arcane Wisdom
Enter Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's last memory

30281301.text: Huh, this sure seems very different from what Paimon imagined... Shouldn't Irminsul be in this realm of consciousness?

30281302.text: Yes, that is our destination, but I didn't expect the remaining consciousness of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata to be as polluted as this.

30281306.text: Forbidden knowledge? Hmm, it seems you know about a concept that even I don't completely understand. Could you tell me what you know?

30281307.text: You tell Nahida all about what you had learned in the desert.

30281309.text: Forbidden knowledge once polluted the desert thousands of years ago, but was successfully repelled thanks to King Deshret's self-sacrifice and Greater Lord Rukkhadevata nearly exhausting her power.

30281310.text: Then a second instance of forbidden knowledge pollution occurred during the Khaenri'ah cataclysm five hundred years ago.

30281311.text: But I'm afraid it is much more serious this time, with Irminsul itself already in danger.

30281312.text: So if we're in the remaining consciousness of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, and it's also been affected by forbidden knowledge pollution, then does that mean, in order to save us, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata...

30281313.text: Yes, it's very possible that she sacrificed her life in the fight against forbidden knowledge.

30281314.text: She didn't completely eradicate forbidden knowledge, but if it weren't for her actions, the pollution would have been far more rampant over these past five hundred years.

30281315.text: The way that everyone, including me, has forgotten everything about forbidden knowledge may very well be due to her restoration of Irminsul.

30281317.text: Aw, do you feel sad, Nahida?

30281318.text: I'm just sharing her pain... The pollution of her consciousness here is severe. There is madness, chaos, and pain all around us.

30281319.text: Did she fight to resist the forbidden knowledge pollution in such terrible conditions, all the way up till her last breath...?

30281320.text: She even used her last remnant of lucid consciousness to leave a clue for us to follow...

subQuests.subQuestName: Leave this place using the Boat of Consciousness

30281601.text: We changed direction. Are we still going the right way, Nahida?

30281602.text: Mm-hmm. Judging from the current route, the Boat of Consciousness will soon take us out of here.

30281603.text: We'll be arriving at our destination soon. How are you feeling? Are your minds still intact?

30281606.text: Huh, but everything's been completely normal for Paimon.

30281607.text: Hopefully, there won't be any more interruptions. This time, we should be able to meet Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

30281608.text: Are you saying you've never met Greater Lord Rukkhadevata before?

30281609.text: No, it seems that my birth and her death took place at the same time.

30281610.text: Otherwise, I think she would have given me a little more guidance, and I could have done a better job.

30281611.text: Hey, you've done a great job, Nahida! Let's get out of this creepy place and go meet her!

subQuests.subQuestName: Reach the Irminsul from the past
Find the remaining consciousness of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata

30281804.text: Uh... we're here to find Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, right?

30281805.text: But the one standing over there is...

30281806.text: Is that... me...? She looks exactly... like me...

30281808.text: Yes, that's me. Are you surprised by my appearance?

30282104.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, I—I'm all right. I'm just a little confused...

30282106.text: We've just saved the world, right?

30282107.text: So why... why am I crying?

30260103.text: Are you awake? Collei says it's time for breakfast. C'mon, get up!

30260105.text: Good morning! How're you feeling today?

30260107.text: Good to hear. It looks like we've recovered pretty well. Not even Tighnari can stop us from going out now, right?

30260109.text: (On that day, we lost consciousness in battle... When we woke up, we found ourselves in Gandharva Ville, and Tighnari and Collei were looking after us.)

30260110.text: (I heard that it was Cyno who brought us here. Tighnari complained that Cyno was always sending people to him, but he has taken great care of us.)

30260111.text: (After completely exhausting ourselves, we had a good rest here. After a few days, we finally recovered enough to be able to go back out.)

30260112.text: (From what Tighnari and Collei have said, the Akasha has been turned off completely, and the people of Sumeru will no longer rely on it.)

30260113.text: (Such a big change will certainly affect people's lives... But it will definitely be a good thing.)

30223601.text: (Someone has knocked these two guards out and removed their Akasha Terminals not long ago. No one seems to have noticed them yet.)

30223602.text: (If they were escorting someone before being knocked out, that person must've escaped.)

30269901.text: Today's the big day! Let's go to the Grand Bazaar and see how the celebration's coming along.

30285001.text: The blond-haired Traveler? How did you come out from the Sanctuary of Surasthana? It's normally forbidden to enter that place.

30285002.text: Um, sorry, we don't know the rules here...

30285003.text: It's fine, just pay more attention next time. Anyway, I'm looking for Grand Sage Azar. Have you seen him?

30285004.text: The more I think about it, the more I believe there's something fishy about Alhaitham's return. I need to let the Grand Sage know somehow...

30285005.text: You're finally starting to put two and two together...

30285101.text: Hey, it's you guys! How did your plan go? Are you here for Nilou?

30285102.text: It went really well! And yeah, where's Nilou?

30285103.text: Great to hear! Nilou's already returned to the Grand Bazaar. Just now, a crowd of Akademiya students came by to ask Nilou for her signature. I've never seen her run away so fast!

30285104.text: To think the Akademiya wants to ban artistic performances... Hehe, I think their students would be the first to disagree.

30285201.text: Eh? How did you find the time to walk around? Did you manage to rescue Lesser Lord Kusanali?

30285202.text: We did! She's handling some Akasha stuff right now.

30285203.text: That's great, haha. Just now, Dehya went to find Asfand, the senior consultant of the Corps of Thirty, and explained everything to him.

30285204.text: In response, Asfand said, "Why didn't you tell me earlier. If it was to rescue the Dendro Archon, we would've helped as well," hahaha...

30285205.text: I didn't know we could have even counted the city guards of the Corps of Thirty among our potential reinforcements. It looks like we were a bit too conservative with our plan.

30289901.text: #We might as well prepare for a fight, {NICKNAME}.

30289902.text: When we're done, we can take a walk around. After all, we missed out on a lot of stuff when we were locked up.

30289906.text: The pattern on the ground seems to be all messed up... Let's go around and see if there's a way to fix it.

30289907.text: It seems to have stopped. Let's continue.

30289909.text: Are we... in the air? And why is there a huge boat!?

30289910.text: That's the Boat of Consciousness, which symbolizes reason here. Its course is the direction our consciousness is traveling towards.

30289911.text: If we lose control over our consciousness, we will fall into madness... So let's make sure the boat stays on course.
